name: vision_ddpm
title: A DDPM trainer: cosine beta schedule in registered buffers, an epsilon-UNet, an EMA copy and an ancestral sampler, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the shape of the reference DDPM implementations - a GaussianDiffusion module holding the schedule, a UNet predicting the noise, and a no_grad sampler run from the EMA weights

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True
a generative trainer has no evaluation loader
the loader is built inside build_loader(), reached only from train() under the __main__ guard
the only pipeline here is the training one; there is no evaluation dataset
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called before every forward
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() in every batch
the order is backward -> clip -> step -> ema.update
the only no_grad regions are p_sample_loop and Ema.update, neither of which back-propagates
the epoch loss accumulates loss.item()
clip_grad_norm_ sits between backward() and step()
p_sample_loop calls model.eval() before the reverse loop and model.train() at the end
p_sample_loop carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project; the objective is F.mse_loss on predicted noise
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the images are moved to the device and the timesteps and noise are allocated with device=
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project
every nn.Module subclass calls super().__init__()
the down and up block lists are nn.ModuleList instances
torch.save writes the two state_dict()s
